rational: Each immutable RationalData owns a lazy CompactOnceBox<CachedRationalArithmetic>, plus a product slot. Binary entries own result rationals and weak references to the other operand. Unary pairs retain one strong result and a weak reverse link. Cache storage includes two binary slots plus unary/square-reduction placeholders; actual occupancy and cost need measurement.
computable: Node owns a lazy synchronized CachedEvaluation. Approximation is monotonic in precision; optional Tower contains only rational coefficients and never retains the expression graph. Fixed-domain radical_tower_declined is distinct from resource exhaustion.
existing_controls: Repeated negation/inverse storage reuse, weak reverse links, cycle-free full drops, unique-owned mutation invalidation, unary-first two-linear-slot capacity and square-reduction coexistence are covered by existing Rational unit tests. No implementation edit or test weakening.
resource_limit: Bounded entry counts do not bound BigUint/BigInt coefficient payload. Weak back-references prevent those direct cycles but are not a complete proof about arbitrary graphs or retained process state.
next: Use observed live allocation sites and lifetime deltas to choose a bounded ownership/dedup experiment, if warranted. Do not evict source/selected proof authority or infer leaks from intentional held-stage exits.
